3:L70-L72"]},"exceptions":{"status":"NONE","items":[]},"summary":"C2 reads May 12–Sep 20 (132 days) of each baseline year 1992–2002 and Jun 1–Aug 31 2007 into npy files. C3 loads them and computes per-cell hazen percentiles for day-of-year rows 138–259 (May 17–Sep 15), whose ±5-day pools together span all baseline days read. The 31-day smoothing at target days 153–244 uses exactly those rows, and the result is compared with every target day for every sea cell before mhw_mask.nc is written."}
